notes.title: Imprecision Full Release!
notes.content:
Imprecision full release is here!
Will transition from Early Access to Full Release tonight! Story is fully implemented with all cutscenes.

Imprecision is a first/third person, action-adventure, rogue-lite set in The Middle Ages. In Imprecision, you play as a lone archer, Örvar, who is training to take down The Black Knights of Bjørn and their kingdom. You are determined to defeat King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty and take back what is yours.

notes.title: Imprecision: Devlog #3 - Intro Cutscene, Olaf, King Bjørn, Borg, and Water!
notes.content:
[b]In these devlogs, I will show you the development process from start to finish, for an archery game called Imprecision. Before I begin developing, I like to brainstorm ideas and create a Game Design Document (GDD). Here is a link to a [url=https://connect-prd-cdn.unity.com/20201215/83f3733d-3146-42de-8a69-f461d6662eb1/Game-Design-Document-Template.pdf]template GDD[/url]. This post will consist of Intro Cutscene, Olaf, King Bjørn, Borg, and Water![/b]

[b]Let's get started![/b]

Halló, dróttinn ferðamaðr! (Hello, adventurer!) We now have the first cutscene that introduces us to the backstory and sends us on our quest, Olaf the wise old man, King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty, and a little water shader! Let's check it out!


[h2]Intro Cutscene[/h2]
The story starts off with Örvar being awoken to chaos. His whole village is a flame and he must flee. He then finds himself in the middle of the forest and meets an old wise man named Olaf. Olaf tells Örvar who has caused the destruction and sends him on a quest to defeat King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty and The Black Knights. The cutscene was made with Unity's Timeline.

[previewyoutube=TYgBK-U_XzQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty[/b][/h2]
King Bjørn, the malevolent and bloodthirsty Viking ruler, casts a dark and foreboding shadow over the nation, commanding unwavering loyalty from his feared and ruthless army, The Black Knights. With a heart devoid of mercy, he has mercilessly seized control of the land, leaving a trail of devastation and despair in his wake. Cunningly adept at manipulation, King Bjørn relishes in the suffering of his adversaries, reveling in the fear he instills among the common folk. As brave heroes prepare to challenge this ominous sovereign, the legend of King Bjørn, a tyrant of unimaginable cruelty, stands as a haunting reminder of the darkness that can emerge from a powerful throne. I use Magicavoxel to model and Mixamo to rig the model. Here is King Bjørn and his axe. He has two axes, which he duel-wields.

King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/ea76a2cd08ee95ee90a80ad91fa31b5d86fb8190.png[/img]
King Bjørn the Bloodthirsty's Axe[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/8fbb52069769812a4227f1964f56ef8130171c63.png[/img]


[h2][b]Borg[/b][/h2]
Level 3 is the castle or fortress of King Bjørn and The Black Knights. You will work your way up and into the fortress. I plan for the player to complete a puzzle to gain access to the fortress.

Level 3 Borg Sneak Peak
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/a71496b2fb2105ee14c5a107742c53dfc75d9b80.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Water[/b][/h2]
I have implemented a little water shader to make the environment feel more natural and real. I couldn't upload a video, but here is a picture.

Water in Imprecision
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/bbfced34be822341c8db575b3867b9c623b3d88c.png[/img]

Imprecision Early Access, available on Steam, Xbox, Android, and IOS.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/15432708684c36a2c541f08f788d94e2f7e22392.png[/img]

notes.title: Imprecision Early Access
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=7BLECNHuz2g;full][/previewyoutube]

Halló, dróttinn ferðamaðr! (Hello, adventurer!) We now have story levels and enemies! Spiders, Cyclops, and The Black Knights! I also have released Imprecision in Early Access on PC/Xbox, Android, iOS, and Steam. The development is coming together!

[h2][b]Story Levels[/b][/h2]
The story levels have began development. Level 1, Skógr (Forest), is available to play in the Early Access version of Imprecision. Level 2, Hol (Cave), and Level 3, Borg (Fortress), are shaping up nicely.

Level 1, Skógr (Forest), of Imprecision
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/34c3b1a1e46dde16db26efa3877fb2b4f79c5fc5.jpg[/img]
The first level of Imprecision, Skógr (Forest)


[h2][b]Enemies[/b][/h2]
Enemy AI's are setup and working for the most part! The current enemies are Spiders (Köngulær)​, Cyclops (Jötnar​), and The Black Knights (Fjölkyngi Drengir​). You will face spiders and a knight in level 1, spiders and ogres in level 2, spiders, an ogre, and knights in level 3. Then fight the King in Level 4 to finish the story. Each enemy has a follow distance and an attack distance. When the player enters the follow distance the enemy will start following. When the enemy is close enough it will attack.

Spider (Könguló) Enemy in Imprecision
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/08a9f2ed45eaa516f070de1719c0da2eb035ee6c.jpg[/img]

Black Knight (Fjölkyngi Drengr) Enemy in Imprecision
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240917/83ffc5217f8c9de992a67f6427d267849398e552.jpg[/img]

Cyclops (Jötunn) Enemy in Imprecision & Sneak Peak of Level 2

[h2][b]Early Access[/b][/h2]
In the Early Access version of Imprecision, you will have access to all 50 Precision Levels and the first level of the story. Level 1 will be missing the cutscenes and story elements. Early Access is available on PC/Xbox, Steam, Android, and IOS. PC/Xbox does not have Xbox Live login yet. Updates will gradually come out. Players can suggest features/ideas in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/8Shu6xTRVP]Discord Server[/url] to help shape the final outcome of Imprecision.

Watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7BLECNHuz2g]Early Access Gameplay Trailer for Imprecision[/url].
